title: Operator Onramp — Shortflow Kit for First-line Support
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight 'Shortflow Kit' in the Console to accelerate first-line support onboarding and reduce mean time to resolution for common incidents. Shortflows are 2–6 step runbooks surfaced as a one-click, permission-gated kiosk for junior operators. This ticket covers the backend adapter, Console surface, telemetry schema, and rollout plan. The intent is to combine existing runbook fragments with a curated, safe default set and instrument each execution for quality/latency regressions.
technical_approach: 1) Define a Shortflow DSL (YAML) that can reference existing runlet snippets and typed inputs. 2) Implement an adapter service in Admin Playbook API to validate, expand, and execute shortflows as idempotent tasks with audit provenance. 3) Add a Console Kiosk panel (read-only for view, one-click execute for permitted roles) with templated prompts and safety checks. 4) Emit structured telemetry for each shortflow invocation (start/step/complete/error) and a per-flow SLI for success rate and median completion time. 5) Gate rollout behind feature flag and RBAC policy. Rollback procedure included.
tasks: Spec Shortflow DSL + example library (owner: PM)
Backend: adapter endpoint POST /shortflows/execute -> returns execution id
Backend: idempotency + audit headers + expanded step tracing
Console: Kiosk UI + permission check + UX copy (design review)
Telemetry: add shortflow.execution.* events and dashboard skeleton
E2E: integration tests + staging rollout behind feature flag
Docs: small quickstart in Console help + onboarding checklist
acceptance_criteria: Create and run a Shortflow consisting of at least 3 existing runlet snippets end-to-end in staging
Execution generates audit log with per-step timestamps and operator id
Console Kiosk shows flow, required inputs, and a one-click execute action for RBAC-permitted users
Telemetry dashboard shows completion rate and P50/P95 step latency for the flow
Feature is toggleable and can be disabled without data loss
Design sign-off from Evelyn Zhao and PM sign-off from Marco Ruiz

design_feedback: Show last-run summary and 'why this flow' blurb for novice operators
Add a lightweight confirmation step for any flow that touches stateful infra
engineering_notes: Reuse runlet execution path to avoid duplication; adapter expands shortflow DSL to runlet list before execution.
Idempotency: require client-supplied token and server-side memoization for 60s to prevent duplicate runs.
Audit: write execution metadata to events stream and also to admin-audit S3 bucket for retention and compliance.
Performance: shortflows targeted to <10s per step median; longer-running steps must show progress and allow cancel.
Fallback: if a runlet fails, we surface cancel/rollback suggestions and capture state for replay in sandbox environment.
review_feedback: Marco Ruiz: Ensure the Quickstart doc includes escalation guidance and links to incident pages.
Evelyn Zhao: Update copy to avoid 'execute' jargon; use 'Run' as primary CTA.
Security: Ensure the adapter enforces least-privilege service account and validates all inputs against allowlists.
deployment_plan: Stage rollout to 10% of orgs for 48h with expanded telemetry alerts
Run a short training session for support rotations and collect feedback
Roll forward to 100% after 1 week without regressions or with agreed mitigations
If failure mode observed: immediately disable flag and open incident with runbook trace
